source.label: R7 combined request (intended lyrics; not a verified transcript)
source.originalLyrics:
[Spoken Intro]
Come closer.
Let me take you back.
This story starts with a window—
And a fight for the view.

[Instrumental Intro]

[Verse 1]
Back when the web was young,
Two giants fought to frame the view.
Netscape faced Explorer,
For the window we looked through.

Netscape opened up its code,
Let more hands inside the frame.
Mozilla kept the work alive;
Then Firefox stepped into the game.

Add a button. Block the tracking.
Make the browser fit your day.
Look beneath the painted surface,
Change the way the pieces play.

More eyes checking all the wiring,
More hands working at the seams.
The doorway had a handle
On our side of the screen.

[Chorus]
Who owns your doorway?
Who decides what you can see?
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse 2]
Open up the app.
See a friend I know.
Find a little shop.
Watch a garden grow.

Every time I pause,
Every clip I save,
Gives the feed a clue.
Shapes the next display.

I can mute a voice.
I can choose a friend.
But the app still sorts
What it wants to send.

[Chorus]
I can choose who I follow.
Can I see how you choose for me?
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse 3]
Make a workshop page.
Here's the time and place.
Use the notes I gave.
Leave some breathing space.

Show me what you wrote.
That sounds like a sale.
Tell them what they'll learn.
Give the plain details.

Check the date again.
Make the link work right.
Wait until I say.
Then put the page online.

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse 4]
Save a note for me:
"Clear words. Skip the pitch."
Read it next time round.
Let me edit it.

The model works with words.
An app connects the tools.
We call that app a harness.
We get to choose its rules.

Let me see its notes.
Let me set its reach.
If I change the model,
Keep the work with me.

[Chorus]
Show the plan. Let me choose.
Ask before you use my tools.
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.

[Instrumental Break]

[Bridge - sung, same groove]
Who owns the toaster?
I choose the bread.
I buy the power.
The tool stays mine.

Keep the notes I made.
Keep the tools I choose.
When I change the model,
Keep my work with me.

[Final Chorus]
Same old question.
A new machine.
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.

[Instrumental Outro]
